title: FiltersPanel: only wired to shapes — filter UI not shown for symbol instances or text fields
description: FiltersPanel in the authoring UI uses selectedShapeFilters targeting selectedShapeId, so it only shows filters for DrawingObjects. Selecting a symbol instance or text field and opening the Filters panel shows nothing. Fix: extend FiltersPanel to also work when the selected object is a SymbolInstance or TextDisplayObject — detect the selection type and show/edit the appropriate filters array.
